# Carolyn Wysinger for El Cerrito City Council
Carolyn Wysinger for El Cerrito City Council
## Let’s create the next generation of progress for El Cerrito.
Let’s keep building on what works.
El Cerrito is a great place to live, and my job is to build on that.
I am a community advocate, an educator, an author, and a city councilmember. In my first term, I worked to increase transparency in local government and to carry El Cerrito’s voice across the region and the state.
I am asking for a second term to keep investing in public safety, infrastructure, economic development, and the quality of life that makes this city a special place to call home.
Progress comes from work we choose to do on behalf of our community, and I will continue to work for the people of El Cerrito as I have done for the past four years.
Join the campaign Volunteer Donate

## Chip in.
With more than 17,000 voters to reach across the city, I need your help to get my message out before ballots are mailed in October. Please make a contribution today so I can send mail, hand out yard signs, and spread the word.
